description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

We are looking for a Senior Project/Program Manager II to be a hands-on partner to our accounting, tax, and O2C leaders. You are an AI wizard, up to date on the newest technology, and ready to support teams through the self supported transition to automated workflows.   You will turn business ideas into well-defined, well-tested system and process improvements, serving as the translator between finance and technical teams from first intake through go-live and hypercare. Over time, you will own a portfolio of projects aligned to these teams, while staying flexible across all three areas because they are closely connected.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except Alaska, Austin Metro, Boulder Metro, California, Chicago Metro, Connecticut, Dallas Metro, Denver Metro, Houston Metro, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Rhode Island, Seattle Metro, and Washington, D.C. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You like solving puzzles: You enjoy untangling a messy process or system problem, determining root cause and impact, and landing on a solution that works.
  • You enjoy making other people’s jobs easier: You get energized by partnering with business stakeholders to make their work more efficient, and you measure success by the problems you take off their plate.
  • You like hands-on work across teams: You would rather be in the details with people from finance, accounting, tax, and IT than managing from a distance, and you build trust by being a reliable partner to each of them.
  • You are a self-starter who works well remotely: You think critically, take ownership of your projects, and keep work moving day to day from your own workspace, with a collaborative team and leaders you can lean on when you need them.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best. 

In this role, you will: 

  • Partner with business stakeholders across accounting  to intake and discuss their challenges and project ideas, assess scope and initial level of effort, identify the right technical resources, and help leaders prioritize work using our project intake framework, including sizing the business backlog (for example, with t-shirt sizes) so you can talk with IT about capacity. Turn those ideas into clear business requirements documents (BRDs) and detailed requirements that state the problem to solve, not the solution design, with defined in-scope and out-of-scope items, and maintain project artifacts such as timelines and RAID logs.
  • Put AI to work, and know it well. You understand how models work under the hood (neural networks, training and backpropagation, tokens and context windows), the difference between a model and the agents and applications built on it, and the difference between LLMs and agentic AI. You consult with business stakeholders on AI solutions that don't need IT to build or support: you know skills, workflows, and MCPs, can spot where AI is the right tool for a problem and where it isn't, and know its limits (hallucinations, security, data privacy). You use it to speed up drafting of requirements, test scenarios, and project reporting, keep a human in the loop, and check every output.  
  • Act as the key contact between business stakeholders and IT teams (such as FinSys, GTMS, and Integrations) through design and development. Translate between finance and technical language, and between IT teams (such as Salesforce, NetSuite, and integrations) to help pinpoint root causes, document key design decisions and trade-offs, and use good judgment on which decisions you can guide and which to bring back to stakeholders for confirmation.
  • Coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT) end to end: draft unit test scenarios and UAT and end-to-end test cases with stakeholder input, maintain the requirements traceability matrix (RTM), manage timelines and tester availability across concurrent projects, triage defects hands-on with business and technical teams (digging into the fields, logic, and formulas to understand how the system should work and why) through resolution and retesting, and provide UAT summaries against entry and exit criteria.
  • Lead go-live readiness and support hypercare, including go/no-go decisions and sign-offs, steering committee updates, and joint business and IT status reporting, escalating risks early.
  • Connect business stakeholders with our enablement teams on SOPs and training materials, and clearly explain what is changing so enablement can work with the business audience to update guides, SOPs, and training to match what is being deployed.
  • Grow into owning a portfolio of projects while remaining flexible across corporate accounting, tax, and O2C, offering guidance to teammates as the team grows.
  • Work with IT in their language: understand agile concepts such as epics, stories, bugs, story points, and sprints, and protect IT's capacity by offering MVPs and phases when a request that looks simple to the business is complex underneath.
  • Build SOX controls into projects: determine which systems are in or out of scope for IT general controls (ITGCs), plan control design and evidence, run user access reviews with IT, and understand how SOC 1 and SOC 2 reports apply to finance systems.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years of project or program management experience, including leading cross-functional projects
  • 2+ years of financial accounting experience
  • Strong understanding of financial accounting (including general ledger accounting, ASC 606 revenue recognition, and accounting for taxes such as sales and use tax) and project management principles
  • Understanding of SOX controls, including key reports, monthly versus quarterly controls, control evidence, and IT general controls (ITGCs), including which systems are in or out of scope
  • Understanding of the accounting close (monthly, quarterly, and annual) and of financial reporting, such as 10-Ks and 10-Qs
  • Experience managing projects through the full lifecycle, from requirements and design through testing and go-live
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to present facts clearly to influence outcomes
  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • Must reside in a US location eligible for this remote role (see location statement above)

An ideal candidate also has:

  • PMP (preferred) or CAPM certification, or a CPA license (active, or inactive and in good standing)
  • Experience with NetSuite, or another ERP such as SAP or Oracle
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, Vertex, and Databricks
  • Experience in revenue accounting, order-to-cash, accounting for tax (such as sales and use tax and how it differs by country), or international accounting
  • Experience writing BRDs, test cases, and UAT plans for finance or accounting systems
  • Working knowledge of agile project management, including epics, stories, bugs, story points, and sprints
  • Experience working with control owners, auditors, and IT on system changes, including ITGC scoping, user access reviews, and familiarity with SOC 1 and SOC 2 reports
  • Experience with Google Workspace and Slack
  • Experience using AI tools to improve efficiency while validating the results

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$115,727—$155,600 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.
